import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem sum_positive_even_powers_mod_three (n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hNotDvd : ¬ (3 : ℤ) ∣ n) : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, n ^ (2 * (i + 1))) ≡ (k : ℤ) [ZMOD 3] := by
  have hnrem : n % 3 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hNotDvd
    exact Int.dvd_iff_emod_eq_zero.mpr h
  
  have hrem_nonneg : 0 ≤ n % 3 := by
    exact Int.emod_nonneg n (by norm_num)
  
  have hrem_lt : n % 3 < 3 := by
    exact Int.emod_lt_of_pos n (by norm_num)
  
  have hrem_cases : n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
    omega
  
  have hsq : n ^ 2 ≡ (1 : ℤ) [ZMOD 3] := by
    rcases hrem_cases with h₁ | h₂
    · have hmod : n ≡ (1 : ℤ) [ZMOD 3] := by
        simpa [Int.ModEq] using h₁
      simpa [Int.ModEq] using hmod.pow 2
    · have hmod : n ≡ (2 : ℤ) [ZMOD 3] := by
        simpa [Int.ModEq] using h₂
      simpa [Int.ModEq] using hmod.pow 2
  
  have hterm (i : ℕ) :
      n ^ (2 * (i + 1)) ≡ (1 : ℤ) [ZMOD 3] := by
    have h := hsq.pow (i + 1)
    simpa [pow_mul] using h
  
  have hsum :
      ∀ m : ℕ,
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, n ^ (2 * (i + 1))) ≡ (m : ℤ) [ZMOD 3] := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
        simp [Int.ModEq]
    | succ m ih =>
        have hadd := ih.add (hterm m)
        simpa [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.cast_succ] using hadd
  
  exact hsum k
